name: Haven Wheel
why_visit: Dock fees and luxury food under Spindle. The municipal navy likes an audience.

bodies.name: Spindle
bodies.blurb: The city-world. Dock fees are painted on the approach.
bodies.legal: Orbital Municipal Navy. A city, not a claim.
bodies.air: City air inside the wheel. Vacuum on the rim.
bodies.life: People, bonded kitchens, no wild stock.
bodies.ruins: The first wheel spoke, still collecting.

bodies.name: Fee Moon
bodies.blurb: The moon where luxury food is priced before it lands.
bodies.legal: Municipal market moon. Scanning is welcome. Planting is not.
bodies.ruins: A tariff nail from the first feast.

belt.name: Fee Chaff
belt.composition: tariff foil and kitchen ash shaken off Spindle, not a stone belt
